q: 把 LLD 设计流程五个阶段按依赖顺序排好：
q_en: Put the five LLD design phases in dependency order.
steps: 实现核心方法并验证场景
why: 每一步的产出是下一步的输入：没有实体边界就定不出类的状态，没有状态和方法签名就没法写实现。
why_en: Each phase's output feeds the next: you need entities before class state, and class APIs before implementation.
diagram:
flowchart TD
A["clarify requirements"] --> B["extract entities"]
B --> C["design class state and behavior"]
C --> D["implement core method"]
D --> E["walk through scenario"]
E --> F["discuss follow-ups"]

scenario: 你正在把「设计 Tic Tac Toe」这句话需求变成可设计的 spec，逐条追问细节。
scenario_en: You are turning the prompt "Design Tic Tac Toe" into a designable spec by asking clarifying questions.
q: 下面哪些追问的答案会直接改变实体或类的设计？（多选）
q_en: Which clarifying answers would directly change the entity or class design? (Select all that apply.)
options: 落子按钮用什么颜色（不影响任何实体或方法签名）
是否要支持 AI 对手（决定要不要为落子逻辑引入 Strategy 接口）
怎样判定获胜或平局（决定 Board 要实现哪些检查方法）
非法操作返回 false 还是抛异常（决定方法的错误处理契约）
options_en: What color the move button is (does not affect any entity or method signature).
Whether an AI opponent is needed (decides if move selection needs a Strategy interface).
How a win or draw is determined (decides which check methods Board must implement).
Whether invalid moves return false or throw (decides the method's error-handling contract).
why: 只有触及状态、规则或错误契约的答案才会改变实体和方法设计；纯展示层选择通常不影响核心模型。
why_en: Only answers touching state, rules, or error contracts should reshape your entities and methods; presentation choices usually should not.

rows: 方法返回值或异常设计

termDefinitions.meaning: 把可替换的算法或策略封装成独立接口，运行时可以互换实现。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The Strategy pattern encapsulates interchangeable algorithms behind a common interface so implementations can be swapped at runtime.

scenario: 题目只给一句话「设计 Tic Tac Toe」，你要把它变成可设计的 spec。
scenario_en: The prompt only says "Design Tic Tac Toe," and you need to turn it into a designable spec.
q: 先追问哪组问题最能定义系统的规则和边界？
q_en: Which set of questions best defines the system rules and scope first?
options: 数据库要分几个分片、CDN 要几个节点
轮流、胜负判定、非法操作、UI/AI 范围
落子逻辑该用哪种设计模式实现
棋盘格子用什么颜色的边框
options_en: How many database shards or CDN nodes to use.
Turn order, win/draw rules, invalid-move handling, and whether UI or AI is in scope.
Which design pattern to use for move logic.
What border color the board cells should have.
whenOtherWins: 如果题目明确是在线多人游戏平台，才需要讨论网络、分片和部署。
tradeoff: 规则与范围澄清 vs 过早跳到实现细节或视觉样式
why: Tic Tac Toe 的核心是规则、结束条件和非法输入；实现模式和界面样式可以晚点再定。
why_en: For Tic Tac Toe, nail down turn order, win conditions, and invalid-move handling first — implementation patterns and visuals can wait.

termDefinitions.meaning: 内容分发网络，把静态内容缓存到离用户更近的节点，和游戏规则无关。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A CDN caches static content on servers closer to users and has nothing to do with game rules.

q: 补全需求阶段产出：
q_en: Complete the requirement-phase output:
text: 需求阶段要写下核心 Requirements，也要写下明确的 {{Out of Scope}}——被排除的功能不需要设计对应的实体或接口，这样类模型才不会{{膨胀}}。
why: 显式排除的功能不用建实体或接口，比如排除网络对战就不用设计 NetworkManager，类模型能保持精简。
why_en: Explicitly out-of-scope features skip their own entities or interfaces — excluding networked play means skipping a NetworkManager class, keeping the model lean.

termDefinitions.meaning: 明确不在本轮设计范围内的功能，面试中先记下但不为它建核心实体或接口。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Out of scope means a feature is explicitly excluded from this design round, so you note it but do not model core entities or APIs for it.

scenario: 你正在把一份需求文档拆解成候选类，需要决定哪些名词值得单独建模成实体。
scenario_en: You are splitting a requirements document into candidate classes and deciding which nouns deserve their own entity.
q: 判断一个名词是否该单独建成实体时，哪些提问有帮助？（多选）
q_en: Which questions help decide whether a noun should become its own entity? (Select all that apply.)
options: 它是否维护会变化的状态
它被其他类引用的次数是否够多
它是否执行或约束重要规则
它是否只是别的对象上的一个字段
options_en: Does it hold state that changes over time?
Is it referenced by enough other classes?
Does it enforce or constrain an important rule?
Is it really just a field on another object?
why: 会变的状态和规则归属指向真正的实体；只是别的对象的一个字段则该留作字段，引用次数不能决定该不该建实体。
why_en: Changing state and rule ownership point to a real entity, while being just a field on another object argues against one; reference count alone does not decide.

scenario: Tic Tac Toe 的需求已经确认：两个玩家、3x3 棋盘、落子、胜负和平局。
scenario_en: The Tic Tac Toe requirements are confirmed: two players, a 3x3 board, moves, wins, and draws.
q: 最合理的初始实体集合是？
q_en: What is the most reasonable initial set of entities?
options: DatabaseShard、Cache、CDN
MouseEvent、Pixel、Theme
Game、Board、Player
Factory、Builder、Singleton
options_en: DatabaseShard, Cache, and CDN.
MouseEvent, Pixel, and Theme.
Game, Board, and Player.
Factory, Builder, and Singleton.
tradeoff: 职责清晰的领域实体 vs 把基础设施组件或设计模式名当成实体
whenOtherWins: 如果后续加入 AI、网络或可变棋盘尺寸，才考虑额外实体。
why: Game 负责编排流程，Board 维护棋盘和胜负检查，Player 表示参与者，都直接来自需求和状态所有权。
why_en: Game, Board, and Player are the core entities because they own the workflow, board state, and participants described in the requirements.

termDefinitions.meaning: 内容分发网络，是基础设施组件，不是游戏领域的业务实体。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A CDN is infrastructure for caching content, not a business entity in the game domain.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用于封装对象创建逻辑的设计模式，不是一个业务实体。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The Factory pattern encapsulates object-creation logic; it is not a business entity.

termDefinitions.meaning: 通过分步骤设置参数来构造复杂对象的设计模式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The Builder pattern constructs a complex object through a step-by-step configuration process.

termDefinitions.meaning: 保证一个类全局只有一个实例的设计模式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The Singleton pattern ensures a class has only one instance globally.

q: 定义实体关系时，最重要的问题之一是什么？
q_en: What is one of the most important questions when defining entity relationships?
options: 谁在继承体系里继承的类数量最多
谁对外暴露的 public 方法数量最多
谁在运行时被实例化的次数最多
谁是 orchestrator，谁拥有持久状态，谁依赖谁
options_en: Which class sits deepest in the inheritance hierarchy.
Which class exposes the most public methods.
Which class gets instantiated most often at runtime.
Who is the orchestrator, who owns durable state, and who depends on whom.
why: 关系决定系统形状：谁驱动流程、谁拥有状态、谁依赖谁，这些答案直接决定后续类设计怎么切。
why_en: Relationships shape the system: knowing the orchestrator, the state owner, and the dependencies directly drives how you split up classes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 驱动主流程、调用其他对象完成整体行为的类。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An orchestrator is the class that drives the main workflow by coordinating other objects.

scenario: 你已经有 Game、Board、Player 三个实体，要开始展开类。
scenario_en: You already have Game, Board, and Player as entities, and now you need to expand them into classes.
q: 通常应先从哪个类开始？
q_en: Which class should you usually start with?
options: 依赖最少的辅助类，比如 Player
orchestrator，例如 Game
最复杂的支持类，比如 Board 的判胜逻辑
所有工具类和辅助方法
options_en: The supporting class with the fewest dependencies, such as Player.
The orchestrator, such as Game.
The most complex supporting class, such as Board's win-checking logic.
All utility classes and helper methods.
tradeoff: 先定驱动主流程的类 vs 先钻进某个支持类的实现细节
whenOtherWins: 如果某个支持类的规则极其复杂，也可以先展开它以尽早暴露风险。
why: orchestrator 驱动主流程，先定它的状态和行为能帮助确定支持类需要暴露什么。
why_en: Start with the orchestrator because it drives the workflow and reveals what supporting classes need to expose.

termDefinitions.meaning: 驱动主流程、调用其他对象完成整体行为的类。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An orchestrator is the class that drives the main workflow by coordinating other objects.

q: 为每个类设计时，应回答哪两个问题？（多选）
q_en: Which two questions should you answer when designing each class? (Select all that apply.)
options: 它是否该直接读写别的类的私有字段
它需要记住什么状态
它能否负责所有事情
它需要提供什么行为或查询
options_en: Should it directly read and write another class's private fields?
What state does it need to remember?
Can it be made responsible for everything?
What behavior or queries does it need to expose?
why: 类设计只从需求推导两件事：状态和行为；直接读写别的类私有字段或做成万能类都违反职责边界。
why_en: Class design derives just two things from requirements — state and behavior; reaching into another class's private fields or making it a god object breaks responsibility boundaries.

scenario: 需求说“两名玩家轮流落子，游戏胜利或平局后结束”。
scenario_en: The requirements say two players take turns, and the game ends on a win or draw.
q: Game 类至少需要哪些状态？
q_en: What state does the Game class need at minimum?
options: board、两个 player、gameState，但省略 currentPlayer 和 winner
只有 board 和 winner，其余用临时变量代替
board、两个 player、currentPlayer、gameState、winner
board、currentPlayer、gameState、winner，但省略两个 player 的引用
options_en: board, both players, and gameState — but missing currentPlayer and winner.
Only board and winner, with everything else in temporary variables.
board, both players, currentPlayer, gameState, and winner.
board, currentPlayer, gameState, and winner — but missing references to both players.
whenOtherWins: 如果不需要单独查询 winner，可由 board 状态推导；但显式字段更不容易漏判胜负。
tradeoff: 状态完备覆盖判定条件 vs 用临时变量或省略字段图省事
why: state 不是凭空列的，而是从规则倒推：少 currentPlayer 分不清轮到谁，少两个 player 引用就没法知道对手是谁、切不了回合。
why_en: State comes straight from the rules: drop currentPlayer and you can't tell whose turn it is; drop the player references and you can't identify the opponent to switch turns to.

termDefinitions.meaning: 游戏当前所处的状态，例如进行中、获胜或平局。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: gameState tracks whether the game is in progress, won, or drawn.

scenario: 需求需要玩家落子、查询当前玩家、查看游戏状态和赢家。
scenario_en: The requirements need players to move, query the current player, and inspect the game state and winner.
q: Game API 的合理方法集合是什么？
q_en: What is a reasonable method set for the Game API?
options: makeMove 和 getBoard，缺少查询当前玩家或赢家的方法
makeMove、getCurrentPlayer、getGameState，但不能查询赢家
只有 makeMove，没有任何查询方法
makeMove、getCurrentPlayer、getGameState、getWinner、getBoard
options_en: makeMove and getBoard only — missing ways to query the current player or winner.
makeMove, getCurrentPlayer, and getGameState — but no way to query the winner.
Only makeMove, with no query methods at all.
makeMove, getCurrentPlayer, getGameState, getWinner, and getBoard.
tradeoff: 覆盖需求隐含的全部操作和查询 vs 只实现动作、遗漏查询方法
whenOtherWins: 如果只要求展示核心行为，可以先只实现 makeMove，getter 留到有时间再补。
why: 方法要覆盖需求里隐含的操作和查询；少了 getWinner 或 getCurrentPlayer，调用方就没法知道轮到谁或谁赢了。
why_en: Methods should cover every operation and query implied by the requirements; drop getWinner or getCurrentPlayer and callers can't tell whose turn it is or who won.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个类对外暴露的方法集合，调用方通过它与该类交互。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An API is the set of methods a class exposes for other code to interact with it.

q: “规则放在拥有相关状态的实体里”体现了什么原则？
q_en: Which principle is shown by putting rules inside the entity that owns the relevant state?
options: 封装 / Tell, Don't Ask
全局变量优先
所有逻辑都放 UI
过度继承
options_en: Encapsulation, also known as Tell, Don't Ask.
Preferring global variables.
Putting all logic in the UI layer.
Overusing inheritance.
why: 对象该管理自己的状态并提供行为，不是把内部数据暴露给调用方拼规则；这样出错时更容易定位到具体类。
why_en: Objects should manage their own state and expose behavior instead of leaking internals for callers to assemble rules, which makes bugs easier to trace to one class.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把状态和操作该状态的逻辑绑定在同一个类里，不对外暴露内部细节。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Encapsulation bundles state with the logic that operates on it and hides internal details from callers.

termDefinitions.meaning: 让对象自己执行操作，而不是先问出它的内部状态再由外部决定怎么做。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Tell, Don't Ask means telling an object to perform an action instead of asking for its internal state and deciding externally.

q: 把实现核心方法的推荐顺序排好：
q_en: Put the recommended core-method implementation sequence in order.
steps: 枚举非法输入、非法状态等边界情况
把正常流程写成清晰伪代码
必要时补充返回值和状态变化
why: 先讲清主流程再补边界情况，叙事不会被 if 分支打断；最后再落到伪代码和状态变化。
why_en: Explaining the happy path before edge cases keeps the narrative clear instead of getting lost in if-branches, then you formalize it as pseudocode with explicit state changes.
diagram:
flowchart TD
A["walk happy path"] --> B["list invalid states and inputs"]
B --> C["write clear pseudocode"]
C --> D["name return values"]
D --> E["show state changes"]

termDefinitions.meaning: 没有异常或错误发生时的主流程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The happy path is the main flow when nothing goes wrong.

scenario: 你要实现 Tic Tac Toe 的 makeMove，展示状态检查、落子、胜负和平局处理。
scenario_en: You are implementing Tic Tac Toe's makeMove to show state checks, placing a mark, win handling, and draw handling.
q: 这段伪代码最重要的结构特征是什么？
q_en: What is the most important structural feature of this pseudocode?
codeSample:
makeMove(player, row, col):
    if state != IN_PROGRESS or player != currentPlayer: return false
    if not board.canPlace(row, col): return false
    board.placeMark(row, col, player.mark)
    if board.checkWin(row, col, player.mark):
        state, winner = WON, player
    elif board.isFull():
        state = DRAW
    else:
        currentPlayer = otherPlayer()
    return true
options: 把所有规则放到 UI
先拒绝非法状态和动作，再执行状态转换
忽略 currentPlayer
只实现 reset
options_en: Put all the rules in the UI layer.
Reject illegal state or moves first, then apply the state transition.
Ignore currentPlayer entirely.
Only implement reset.
tradeoff: 前置校验保证不变量 vs 直接改状态、事后再补校验
whenOtherWins: 如果要用异常表达失败而不是布尔返回值，可以把 return false 换成 throw，但校验-变更-判定终局的顺序不变。
why: 核心方法要让流程可追踪：前置校验、改变状态、计算结束条件、更新下一步状态。
why_en: The method stays traceable by validating first, applying the move, checking terminal states, and only then advancing the turn.
diagram:
stateDiagram-v2
[*] --> IN_PROGRESS
IN_PROGRESS --> WON : checkWin
IN_PROGRESS --> DRAW : board full
IN_PROGRESS --> IN_PROGRESS : valid non-terminal move
WON --> [*]
DRAW --> [*]

termDefinitions.meaning: 函数开头用来提前拒绝非法输入或非法状态的判断语句。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A guard clause is an early check that rejects invalid input or state before the main logic runs.

termDefinitions.meaning: Game 的三种状态：进行中、已获胜、已平局。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: IN_PROGRESS, WON, and DRAW are the three states a Game can be in.

q: 在实现阶段强行塞 Singleton、Factory、Builder 等模式的常见风险是什么？
q_en: What is the common risk of forcing Singleton, Factory, or Builder into the implementation phase?
options: 一定提升可读性
能替代需求澄清
过度设计，浪费时间并模糊核心逻辑
保证所有 follow-up 自动解决
options_en: It always improves readability.
It can substitute for requirements clarification.
Overengineering — it wastes time and obscures the core logic.
It guarantees every follow-up question is automatically handled.
why: 模式只有在解决真实变化点时才有价值；大多数 LLD 题更需要清楚的类和核心方法。
why_en: Patterns only pay off when they address a real point of variation; most LLD problems need clear classes and core methods more than pattern ceremony.

termDefinitions.meaning: 保证一个类全局只有一个实例的设计模式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The Singleton pattern ensures a class has only one instance globally.

termDefinitions.meaning: 封装对象创建逻辑，让调用方不用关心具体子类的设计模式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The Factory pattern encapsulates object-creation logic so callers do not depend on concrete subclasses.

termDefinitions.meaning: 通过分步骤设置参数构造复杂对象的设计模式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The Builder pattern constructs a complex object through a step-by-step configuration process.

scenario: 你刚写完 makeMove 的伪代码，要用一个具体走查来验证逻辑，而不是只读代码。
scenario_en: You just wrote makeMove pseudocode and need a concrete walkthrough to verify the logic, not just read the code.
q: 一次好的走查应该覆盖哪些内容？（多选）
q_en: What should a good walkthrough cover? (Select all that apply.)
options: 初始状态
只口头描述，不用具体输入输出
每一步操作发生了什么
每步后状态如何变化
options_en: The initial state.
Only a verbal description without concrete inputs and outputs.
What happens on each operation.
How state changes after each step.
why: 走查要从初始状态开始，逐步核对每次操作后的状态变化，才能抓到轮次没切换、胜负没触发这类 bug。
why_en: A trace starts from a concrete initial state and checks the state after every operation, which is how you catch bugs like a turn that never switches or a win that never triggers.

scenario: 新增需求：Tic Tac Toe 要支持撤销最近一步棋（undo）。
scenario_en: New requirement: Tic Tac Toe must support undoing the most recent move.
q: 最直接的实现方向是什么？
q_en: What is the most direct implementation direction?
options: 把所有类推倒重写，连带删掉 Board 里记录落子的方式
在 UI 按钮的点击处理函数里直接改字段，不经过 Game 的方法
给每一个方法都加事务日志，undo 时回滚整个应用状态而不只是棋盘
因为状态变化集中在 makeMove，加一个命令历史栈，记录每次成功落子前的状态，undo 时弹栈回滚
options_en: Rewrite every class from scratch, including how Board tracks placed marks.
Mutate fields directly inside the UI button's click handler, bypassing Game's methods.
Add a transaction log to every method and roll back the entire application state, not just the board.
Since state changes are centralized in makeMove, add a command history stack that records the prior state before each successful move, and undo pops it.
tradeoff: 复用集中式状态变更点 vs 为 undo 重建应用级事务机制
whenOtherWins: 如果状态很大或历史很多，需要讨论快照、命令差量和内存成本。
why: 扩展回答要指向现有设计的边界：状态变化集中在一处，就能在一个地方记录和撤销。
why_en: A good extension answer points at the existing design boundary: because state mutation is centralized, you can record and undo it in one place.
diagram:
flowchart TD
A["makeMove is the only state-changing path"] --> B["record successful move"]
B --> C["push prior state to history"]
C --> D["undo pops history"]
D --> E["restore board, turn, state, winner"]

termDefinitions.meaning: 记录每次操作前状态的栈结构，undo 时弹出最近一条记录来回滚。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A command history stack records the state before each action so undo can pop the most recent entry and roll back.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把一次操作封装成对象，可以记录、排队或撤销。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The Command pattern encapsulates an action as an object so it can be logged, queued, or undone.

q: 补全类设计口诀：
q_en: Complete the class-design rule of thumb:
text: 逐个实体回答两个问题：这个类要记住什么{{状态}}，以及它要提供什么{{行为}}。
why: 状态和行为都从需求来，能避免类变成空壳或万能对象。
why_en: Both state and behavior should come from the requirements, which keeps a class from becoming an empty shell or a god object.

scenario: 候选人拿到 Tic Tac Toe 需求后立刻开始写 makeMove 的代码，没有先列实体和类结构。
scenario_en: A candidate gets the Tic Tac Toe requirements and immediately writes makeMove without first listing entities and classes.
q: 这样做最可能造成什么技术后果？
q_en: What technical consequence is this most likely to cause?
options: 职责边界不清晰，规则和状态检查散落在各处、后续要返工
跳过设计直接写代码，通常代码一定能更快完成
跳过设计阶段，需求反而会自动变得清楚
跳过设计阶段，系统的扩展性反而一定更好
options_en: Responsibility boundaries stay unclear — rules and state checks end up scattered and need rework later.
Skipping design and jumping to code usually finishes the code faster.
Skipping the design phase makes requirements automatically clearer.
Skipping the design phase automatically makes the system more extensible.
why: 没有先建立实体和职责边界，规则会被随手写进当前方法，之后要把逻辑挪回正确的类里，等于返工。
why_en: Without first establishing entities and ownership, rules get written wherever is convenient and later have to be moved into the right class — that is rework.

scenario: 候选人在类设计阶段反复打磨每一个 getter 和辅助方法的细节。
scenario_en: During class design, the candidate keeps polishing every getter and helper method in detail.
q: 这样做最可能导致什么技术后果？
q_en: What technical consequence is this most likely to lead to?
options: 花更多时间打磨细节，需求一定会变得更准确
核心方法的状态转换逻辑没写完，也没时间走查验证
打磨到足够细致后，就不需要再实现任何方法
把每个方法都打磨完善，系统会自动变得可扩展
options_en: Spending more time polishing details always makes requirements more accurate.
The core state-transition logic never gets finished, and there is no time left to verify it.
Once details are polished enough, no methods need to be implemented at all.
Polishing every method automatically makes the system more extensible.
why: 过度打磨次要方法会挤占核心状态转换和走查验证的时间，那才是暴露设计是否正确的部分。
why_en: Over-polishing minor methods eats into the time needed for the core state-transition logic and its verification, which is what actually proves the design correct.

scenario: 时间只够实现两个方法，但类里列了很多 getter、reset、helper。
scenario_en: There is only enough time to implement two methods, but the class lists many getters, reset methods, and helpers.
q: 应该优先实现哪些？
q_en: Which methods should you implement first?
options: 所有 getter
最短的方法
真正定义系统行为和状态转换的核心方法
最像设计模式的方法
options_en: All the getters.
Whichever methods are shortest.
The core methods that actually define behavior and state transitions.
Whichever methods look most like a design pattern.
tradeoff: 优先展示状态转换逻辑 vs 优先展示访问器或形式上的模式使用
whenOtherWins: 如果某个查询方法本身包含复杂规则，比如带条件的 getWinner，它也值得优先实现。
why: 实现阶段要把系统如何运转讲清楚；getter 通常不展示设计能力，除非它涉及关键规则。
why_en: Implementation should show how the system actually works; plain getters rarely demonstrate design skill unless they encode real rules.

scenario: makeMove 的核心逻辑写完之后，你要主动补充边界情况。
scenario_en: After the core makeMove logic is written, you need to proactively add edge cases.
q: 哪些边界情况值得主动提出？（多选）
q_en: Which edge cases are worth proactively calling out? (Select all that apply.)
options: 完全无关的未来大功能，例如联机对战
非法输入，例如越界的 row/col
当前状态下不允许的操作，例如游戏已经结束时落子
已被占用的格子
options_en: An unrelated future feature, such as networked multiplayer.
Invalid input, such as an out-of-range row or col.
Operations not allowed in the current state, such as moving after the game has ended.
A cell that is already occupied.
why: 边界情况要贴着当前方法的前置条件；无关的未来功能属于范围膨胀，不该现在提。
why_en: Edge cases should map to the current method's preconditions; unrelated future features are scope creep and do not belong here.

q: 把 Tic Tac Toe 走查的顺序排好：
q_en: Put the Tic Tac Toe walkthrough sequence in order.
steps: 说明初始棋盘为空且 currentPlayer 为 X
执行 O 的一步并切回 X
执行 X 的一步并切到 O
继续到胜利或平局并确认 state/winner 更新
why: 走查要按具体操作推进，检查每一步状态变化是否符合规则，才能抓到轮次没切换、胜负没触发这类 bug。
why_en: A trace should advance through concrete moves and check the state after each one, which is how you catch a turn that never switches or a win that never triggers.

scenario: 你发现自己准备实现 UI 渲染、AI 对手、网络多人和 undo，但这些都没在需求里。
scenario_en: You notice you are about to implement UI rendering, an AI opponent, networked multiplayer, and undo, but none are in the requirements.
q: 应该怎么处理？
q_en: How should you handle that?
options: 把 UI、AI、网络多人和 undo 全部实现，以此展示自己的能力
删掉已经写好的核心游戏逻辑，腾出时间做这些功能
只实现 UI 渲染，把其余三项都无限期搁置
把它们记为 out of scope 或 follow-up，不在核心设计里实现
options_en: Implement UI, AI, networking, and undo all at once to show off capability.
Delete the core game logic you already wrote to make time for these features.
Implement only the UI and leave the other three indefinitely.
Record them as out of scope or follow-ups, and do not build them into the core design.
tradeoff: 先交付确认过的核心需求 vs 提前实现未确认的扩展功能
whenOtherWins: 如果其中某项后来被确认为核心需求，就把它纳入范围并重新评估实体模型。
why: 设计精力有限，核心需求要先完整实现；额外功能留作扩展讨论，不该抢走主线。
why_en: Design effort is limited, so the core requirements should be complete first; extra features stay as later discussion, not the main line of work.

scenario: 你要把 Game 类的设计画出来，既要让人看出它的状态，也要看出它对外暴露的操作。
scenario_en: You need to draw the Game class so the interviewer can see both its state and the operations it exposes.
q: 哪种表示法完整传达了类的设计？
q_en: Which notation fully communicates the class design?
options: State 区列出字段和类型，下面列出 +makeMove(...) 等带参数和返回类型的方法
白板上只列出方法名，不写参数、返回类型，也不写任何状态字段
白板上只写 Game 这一个单词，不做任何展开说明
把类里所有字段都标成 public，方便外部代码直接读写
options_en: A State section listing typed fields, plus methods like +makeMove(...) with parameters and return types.
List only the method names on the whiteboard, with no parameters, return types, or state fields.
Write only the word Game on the whiteboard, with no further detail.
Mark every field in the class public so external code can read and write them directly.
tradeoff: 状态与行为都可核对 vs 只有名字、无法核对封装或契约
whenOtherWins: 如果面试官要求真实代码，可以直接把这个轮廓转成语言里的类定义。
why: 类设计要能核对两件事：字段是什么类型，方法的参数和返回值是什么；全 public 字段等于放弃封装。
why_en: A class design must let you check two things — the type of each field and the signature of each method — and making every field public throws away encapsulation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 方法名加上参数类型和返回类型，定义了调用契约。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A method signature is the method name plus its parameter and return types, defining the calling contract.

q: 补全交付框架总结：
q_en: Complete the delivery-framework summary:
text: LLD 设计要按顺序覆盖：{{需求}}、{{实体关系}}、{{类设计}}、{{核心实现}}、{{验证/扩展}}。
why: 这不是死板模板，而是保证结构、契约和状态转换在设计完成前都被覆盖到。
why_en: This is not a rigid template — it just makes sure structure, contracts, and state transitions all get covered before the design is done.
